+"""project tracking fields (Wave 9 / Agent Epsilon)
+
+Revision ID: 0014_project_tracking
+Revises: 0009_id_sequences
+Create Date: 2026-06-22
+
+Additive changes to `projects` table:
+- business_id (UNIQUE) — auto-generated SWA-2025-PRJ-NNN via id_gen
+- milestone — "Concept", "DBR", "Calculation", "Drawing", "Validation", "Closeout"
+- progress_indicators (JSONB) — e.g. {"design_pct": 30, "calc_pct": 10, "drawing_pct": 0}
+- status_updates (TEXT)
+- team_leader_id (UUID FK→users.id)
+- project_owner_id (UUID FK→users.id)
+- notes (TEXT)
+
+Backfills business_id for any existing rows by allocating a contiguous
+block from the id_sequence counter and updating id_sequence.last_value
+so future calls do not collide.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+from sqlalchemy.dialects import postgresql
+
+
+revision = "0014_project_tracking"
+down_revision = "0009_id_sequences"
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("business_id", sa.String(length=64), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("milestone", sa.String(length=50), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("progress_indicators", postgresql.JSONB(), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("status_updates", sa.Text(), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("team_leader_id", postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("project_owner_id", postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("notes", sa.Text(), nullable=True),
+    )
+
+    op.create_foreign_key(
+        "fk_projects_team_leader_id_users",
+        "projects",
+        "users",
+        ["team_leader_id"],
+        ["id"],
+        ondelete="SET NULL",
+    )
+    op.create_foreign_key(
+        "fk_projects_project_owner_id_users",
+        "projects",
+        "users",
+        ["project_owner_id"],
+        ["id"],
+        ondelete="SET NULL",
+    )
+
+    op.execute(
+        """
+        DO $$
+        DECLARE
+            yr INT := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::INT;
+            counter INT := 0;
+            seq_exists BOOLEAN;
+            rec RECORD;
+        BEGIN
+            SELECT EXISTS (
+                SELECT 1 FROM id_sequence WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr
+            ) INTO seq_exists;
+
+            IF seq_exists THEN
+                SELECT last_value INTO counter FROM id_sequence
+                WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr;
+            END IF;
+
+            FOR rec IN SELECT id FROM projects WHERE business_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LOOP
+                counter := counter + 1;
+                UPDATE projects
+                SET business_id = 'SWA-' || yr || '-PRJ-' || LPAD(counter::TEXT, 3, '0')
+                WHERE id = rec.id;
+            END LOOP;
+
+            IF seq_exists THEN
+                UPDATE id_sequence
+                SET last_value = counter
+                WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr;
+            ELSIF counter > 0 THEN
+                INSERT INTO id_sequence (type_code, year, last_value)
+                VALUES ('PRJ', yr, counter);
+            END IF;
+        END $$;
+        """
+    )
+
+    op.execute("UPDATE projects SET milestone = 'Concept' WHERE milestone IS NULL")
+
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_business_id",
+        "projects",
+        ["business_id"],
+        unique=True,
+    )
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_milestone",
+        "projects",
+        ["milestone"],
+        unique=False,
+    )
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_team_leader_id",
+        "projects",
+        ["team_leader_id"],
+        unique=False,
+    )
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_project_owner_id",
+        "projects",
+        ["project_owner_id"],
+        unique=False,
+    )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_project_owner_id", table_name="projects")
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_team_leader_id", table_name="projects")
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_milestone", table_name="projects")
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_business_id", table_name="projects")
+
+    op.drop_constraint("fk_projects_project_owner_id_users", "projects", type_="foreignkey")
+    op.drop_constraint("fk_projects_team_leader_id_users", "projects", type_="foreignkey")
+
+    op.drop_column("projects", "notes")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "project_owner_id")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "team_leader_id")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "status_updates")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "progress_indicators")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "milestone")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "business_id")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+from datetime import date
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.service_agreement import ServiceAgreement
+
+
+def list_agreements(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    status: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int]:
+    query = db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+
+    if client_id is not None:
+        query = query.filter(ServiceAgreement.client_id == client_id)
+    if status:
+        query = query.filter(ServiceAgreement.status == status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(ServiceAgreement.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def get_agreement(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    return db.query(ServiceAgreement).filter(ServiceAgreement.id == agreement_id).first()
+
+
+def get_agreement_by_business_id(db: Session, agreement_business_id: str) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    return (
+        db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+        .filter(ServiceAgreement.agreement_id == agreement_business_id)
+        .first()
+    )
+
+
+def create_agreement(
+    db: Session,
+    *,
+    agreement_id: str,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    service_name: str,
+    start_date: date,
+    end_date: date | None,
+    total_tokens: int | None,
+    billing_model: str,
+    status: str,

+) -> ServiceAgreement:

+ALLOWED_TOKEN_TRANSITIONS: dict[TokenStatus, set[TokenStatus]] = {
+    TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS: {TokenStatus.CLOSED, TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW, TokenStatus.CANCELLED},

+    TokenStatus.CLOSED: {TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW},
+    TokenStatus.CANCELLED: set(),
+}
+
+
+def can_transition_token_status(from_status: TokenStatus, to_status: TokenStatus) -> bool:

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid

+

+from src.backend.db.repositories import agreement_repo, audit_repo, inquiry_repo
+from src.backend.models.inquiry import Inquiry
+from src.backend.models.service_agreement import (
+    AgreementStatus,
+    BillingModel,
+    ServiceAgreement,
+)

+    ServiceAgreementUpdate,
+)
+
+
+def list_agreements_service(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    status: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int, int, int]:
+    items, total = agreement_repo.list_agreements(
+        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, client_id=client_id, status=status
+    )
+    return items, total, page, page_size
+
+
+def list_agreements_by_client_service(
+    db: Session,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int, int, int]:
+    items, total = agreement_repo.list_agreements(
+        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, client_id=client_id
+    )
+    return items, total, page, page_size
+
+
+def get_agreement_service(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    return agreement_repo.get_agreement(db, agreement_id)
+
+
+def create_agreement_service(
+    db: Session,
+    data: ServiceAgreementCreate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> ServiceAgreement:
+    inquiry: Inquiry | None = None
+    if data.inquiry_id is not None:
+        inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, data.inquiry_id)
+        if not inquiry:
+            raise LookupError(f"inquiry {data.inquiry_id} not found")
+
+    business_id = next_business_id(db, "SA", date.today().year)
+    agreement = agreement_repo.create_agreement(
+        db,
+        agreement_id=business_id,
+        client_id=data.client_id,
+        inquiry_id=data.inquiry_id,
+        service_name=data.service_name,
+        start_date=data.start_date,
+        end_date=data.end_date,
+        total_tokens=data.total_tokens,
+        billing_model=data.billing_model.value,
+        status=data.status.value,
+        notes=data.notes,
+    )
+
+    if inquiry is not None:
+        if inquiry.converted_to_agreement_id is None:
+            inquiry.converted_to_agreement_id = agreement.id
+
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="agreement.create",
+        entity_type="service_agreement",
+        entity_id=agreement.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        after_json={
+            "agreement_id": agreement.agreement_id,
+            "client_id": str(agreement.client_id),
+            "inquiry_id": str(agreement.inquiry_id) if agreement.inquiry_id else None,
+            "service_name": agreement.service_name,
+        },
+    )
+    agreement_repo.commit_agreement(db, agreement)
+    return agreement
+
+
+def update_agreement_service(
+    db: Session,
+    agreement_id: uuid.UUID,
+    data: ServiceAgreementUpdate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    agreement = agreement_repo.get_agreement(db, agreement_id)
+    if not agreement:
+        return None
+
+    before = {
+        "service_name": agreement.service_name,
+        "status": agreement.status,
+        "billing_model": agreement.billing_model,
+    }
+
+    if data.service_name is not None:
+        agreement.service_name = data.service_name
+    if data.start_date is not None:
+        agreement.start_date = data.start_date
+    if data.end_date is not None:
+        agreement.end_date = data.end_date
+    if data.total_tokens is not None:
+        agreement.total_tokens = data.total_tokens
+    if data.billing_model is not None:
+        agreement.billing_model = data.billing_model.value
+    if data.status is not None:
+        agreement.status = data.status.value
+    if data.notes is not None:
+        agreement.notes = data.notes
+
+    after = {
+        "service_name": agreement.service_name,
+        "status": agreement.status,
+        "billing_model": agreement.billing_model,
+    }
+
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="agreement.update",
+        entity_type="service_agreement",
+        entity_id=agreement.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json=before,
+        after_json=after,
+    )
+    agreement_repo.commit_agreement(db, agreement)
+    return agreement
+
+
+def delete_agreement_service(
+    db: Session,
+    agreement_id: uuid.UUID,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> bool:
+    agreement = agreement_repo.get_agreement(db, agreement_id)
+    if not agreement:
+        return False
+
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="agreement.delete",
+        entity_type="service_agreement",
+        entity_id=agreement.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"agreement_id": agreement.agreement_id, "service_name": agreement.service_name},
+    )
+    agreement_repo.delete_agreement(db, agreement)
+    return True

+def update_inquiry_service(
+    db: Session,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
+    data: InquiryUpdate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> Inquiry | None:
+    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
+    if not inquiry:
+        return None
+
+    before = {
+        "status": inquiry.status,
+        "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
+        "inquiry_type": inquiry.inquiry_type,
+        "priority": inquiry.priority,
+    }
+
+    if data.inquiry_date is not None:
+        inquiry.inquiry_date = data.inquiry_date
+    if data.inquiry_type is not None:
+        inquiry.inquiry_type = data.inquiry_type.value

+    if data.client_name is not None:

+    if data.estimated_value is not None:

+    )
+    inquiry_repo.delete_inquiry(db, inquiry)
+    return True

+
+VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES = {s.value for s in InquiryStatus}
+
+
+def transition_inquiry_service(
+    db: Session,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: InquiryStatus,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    *,
+    client_code: str | None = None,
+    client_primary_email: str | None = None,
+    service_name: str | None = None,
+    start_date: date | None = None,
+) -> tuple[Inquiry, "ServiceAgreement | None"]:
+    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
+    if not inquiry:
+        raise LookupError("inquiry not found")
+
+    if new_status.value not in VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid status: {new_status}")
+
+    before_status = inquiry.status
+
+    if new_status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED:
+        if inquiry.status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED.value:
+            raise InquiryAlreadyConvertedError("inquiry already converted")
+        missing: list[str] = []
+        if not client_code:
+            missing.append("client_code")
+        if not client_primary_email:
+            missing.append("client_primary_email")
+        if not service_name:
+            missing.append("service_name")
+        if start_date is None:
+            missing.append("start_date")
+        if missing:
+            raise ValueError(f"missing required fields for Converted: {', '.join(missing)}")
+
+        assert client_code and client_primary_email and service_name and start_date is not None
+
+        from src.backend.db.repositories import agreement_repo
+
+        business_id = next_business_id(db, "SA", date.today().year)
+        client, agreement = inquiry_repo.convert_inquiry(
+            db,
+            inquiry,
+            client_code=client_code,
+            client_primary_email=client_primary_email,
+            service_name=service_name,
+            start_date=start_date,
+        )
+        agreement.agreement_id = business_id
+        agreement.client_id = client.id
+        db.flush()
+
+        audit_repo.create_entry(
+            db,
+            action="inquiry.convert",
+            entity_type="inquiry",
+            entity_id=inquiry.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json={"status": before_status},
+            after_json={
+                "status": inquiry.status,
+                "client_id": str(client.id),
+                "agreement_id": str(agreement.id),
+            },
+        )
+        db.commit()
+        db.refresh(inquiry)
+        db.refresh(agreement)
+        return inquiry, agreement
+
+    inquiry.status = new_status.value
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="inquiry.status_transition",
+        entity_type="inquiry",
+        entity_id=inquiry.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"status": before_status},
+        after_json={"status": inquiry.status},
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(inquiry)
+    return inquiry, None

from collections.abc import Callable

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.security import decode_token
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import get_by_id
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.models.user import User

security_scheme = HTTPBearer()


def get_current_user(
    creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security_scheme),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
) -> User:
    try:
        payload = decode_token(creds.credentials)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired token") from e
    if payload.get("type") != "access":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Wrong token type")
    user = get_by_id(db, UUID(payload["sub"]))
    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="User not active")
    return user


def require_role(required: Role) -> Callable[[User], User]:
    def _checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:  # noqa: B008
        if not role_includes(Role(user.role), required):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Insufficient role")
        return user

    return _checker

"""Business-ID generator.

Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
(`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.

Pass `year=0` for "continuous across years" (per meeting: DBR/CAS/GAD numbers
do not reset per year).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence


def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()

    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

import uuid
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.client import Client


def list_clients(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[Client], int]:
    query = db.query(Client).filter(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            Client.name.ilike(search) | Client.code.ilike(search) | Client.primary_email.ilike(search)
        )

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Client.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, client_id: uuid.UUID) -> Client | None:
    return db.query(Client).filter(Client.id == client_id, Client.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    name: str,
    code: str,
    primary_email: str,
    address: str | None = None,
    city: str | None = None,
    state: str | None = None,
    pincode: str | None = None,
    country: str = "India",
    gst_number: str | None = None,
    primary_phone: str | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> Client:
    client = Client(
        name=name,
        code=code,
        primary_email=primary_email,
        address=address,
        city=city,
        state=state,
        pincode=pincode,
        country=country,
        gst_number=gst_number,
        primary_phone=primary_phone,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(client)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def update(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def soft_delete(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    client.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client

_bcrypt.gensalt = _fast_gensalt

TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(
    autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False
)


def _reset_tables():
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'"))
        existing = {r[0] for r in result}
        # sorted_tables is in dependency order (parents first); delete children first
        tables = [t.name for t in Base.metadata.sorted_tables if t.name in existing]
        # Use DELETE instead of TRUNCATE to avoid AccessExclusiveLock deadlocks
        # against idle connections from the SQLAlchemy pool.
        for tbl in reversed(tables):
            conn.execute(text(f"DELETE FROM {tbl}"))
        # Restart sequences
        if tables:
            seq_result = conn.execute(text(
                "SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relkind = 'S' AND relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace"
            ))
            for row in seq_result:
                conn.execute(text(f"ALTER SEQUENCE {row[0]} RESTART WITH 1"))
        conn.commit()

def setup_test_db():
    # Dispose pool to kill any leftover connections from previous runs
    engine.dispose()
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine, checkfirst=True)
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'"))
        created = [r[0] for r in result]
        print(f"[setup_test_db] Created tables: {created}")
    yield
    # Just dispose the pool; don't drop tables to avoid deadlocks with pooled connections
    engine.dispose()

import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.boq_parser import parse_excel, parse_json
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.boq_repo import create_boq, get_next_version_number

UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/boqs")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024  # 10MB
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".xlsx", ".json"}


def _ensure_dir(project_id: uuid.UUID) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / str(project_id)
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(project_id: uuid.UUID, file_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> str:
    d = _ensure_dir(project_id)
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{file_name}"
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    return str(path)


def upload_boq(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    file_bytes: bytes,
    file_name: str,
    content_type: str | None,
    parsed_by: uuid.UUID | None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 10MB limit")

    ext = Path(file_name).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS}")

    if ext == ".xlsx":
        items = parse_excel(file_bytes)
    else:
        items = parse_json(file_bytes)

    if not items:
        raise ValueError("No valid line items found in file")

    file_path = _save_file(project_id, file_name, file_bytes)
    version_number = get_next_version_number(db, project_id)

    boq = create_boq(
        db=db,
        project_id=project_id,
        version_number=version_number,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_path=file_path,
        parsed_by=parsed_by,
        items=items,
        notes=notes,
    )

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="boq.upload",
        entity_type="boq",
        entity_id=boq.id,
        user_id=parsed_by,
        after_json={
            "project_id": str(project_id),
            "version_number": version_number,
            "file_name": file_name,
            "items_count": len(items),
        },
    )

    return {
        "id": boq.id,
        "project_id": boq.project_id,
        "version_number": boq.version_number,
        "file_name": boq.file_name,
        "file_path": boq.file_path,
        "parsed_by": boq.parsed_by,
        "parsed_at": boq.parsed_at,
        "notes": boq.notes,
        "is_active": boq.is_active,
        "created_at": boq.created_at,
        "item_count": len(items),
    }

import uuid
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.project_repo import (
    create_project,
    get_project_with_names,
    list_projects_with_names,
    soft_delete_project,
    update_project,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.project_repo import (
    get_by_id as get_project_by_id,
)
from src.backend.models.project import Project
from src.backend.schemas.project import Milestone, ProjectCreate, ProjectUpdate


def create_project_service(
    db: Session,
    data: ProjectCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = data.model_dump()
    if not payload.get("business_id"):
        payload["business_id"] = next_business_id(db, "PRJ")
    if not payload.get("milestone"):
        payload["milestone"] = Milestone.CONCEPT.value
    project = create_project(db, payload)

    result = get_project_with_names(db, project.id)
    if result:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="project.create",
            entity_type="project",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=project.id,
            after_json=_project_to_dict(project),
        )

    return result


def get_project_service(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return get_project_with_names(db, project_id)


def list_projects_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    milestone: str | None = None,
    team_leader: uuid.UUID | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int, int, int]:
    return list_projects_with_names(
        db,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        q=q,
        status=status,
        milestone=milestone,
        team_leader=team_leader,
    )


def update_project_service(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: ProjectUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
    if not project:
        return None

    before_json = _project_to_dict(project)

    update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    update_project(db, project_id, update_data)

    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
    after_json = _project_to_dict(project)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="project.update",
        entity_type="project",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=project_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return get_project_with_names(db, project_id)


def soft_delete_project_service(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
    if not project:
        return False

    before_json = _project_to_dict(project)

    success = soft_delete_project(db, project_id)

    if success:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="project.delete",
            entity_type="project",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=project_id,
            before_json=before_json,
        )

    return success


def record_event(
    db: Session,
    action: str,
    entity_type: str,
    user_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    entity_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    before_json: dict | None = None,
    after_json: dict | None = None,
) -> None:
    create_entry(
        db,
        action=action,
        entity_type=entity_type,
        user_id=user_id,
        entity_id=entity_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )


def _project_to_dict(project: Project) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": str(project.id),
        "client_id": str(project.client_id),
        "name": project.name,
        "code": project.code,

        "start_date": str(project.start_date) if project.start_date else None,
        "target_end_date": str(project.target_end_date) if project.target_end_date else None,
        "actual_end_date": str(project.actual_end_date) if project.actual_end_date else None,

    }

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.user import User


def get_by_email(db: Session, email: str) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.email == email, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def get_by_id(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def list_users(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[User], int]:
    query = db.query(User).filter(User.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(User.email.ilike(search) | User.name.ilike(search))

    if role:
        query = query.filter(User.role == role)

    if is_active is not None:
        query = query.filter(User.is_active == is_active)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(User.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def create(db: Session, email: str, name: str, password_hash: str, role: str) -> User:
    user = User(
        email=email,
        name=name,
        password_hash=password_hash,
        role=role,
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def update(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def soft_delete(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    user.deleted_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    Date,
    DateTime,
    ForeignKey,
    Numeric,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
    func,
)
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from src.backend.db.base import Base
from src.backend.models.enums import TaskPriority, TaskStatus


class Task(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tasks"

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    project_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("projects.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    parent_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("tasks.id"), nullable=True, index=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default=TaskStatus.TODO.value)
    priority: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default=TaskPriority.MEDIUM.value)
    assignee_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True, index=True)
    created_by: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False)
    due_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    estimated_hours: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(6, 2), nullable=True)
    actual_hours: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(6, 2), nullable=True)
    boq_item_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("boq_items.id"), nullable=True)
    is_deleted: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)

    project: Mapped["Project"] = relationship("Project", back_populates="tasks")
    parent: Mapped["Task"] = relationship("Task", remote_side=[id], back_populates="subtasks")
    subtasks: Mapped[list["Task"]] = relationship("Task", back_populates="parent", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    assignee: Mapped["User"] = relationship("User", foreign_keys=[assignee_id])
    creator: Mapped["User"] = relationship("User", foreign_keys=[created_by])
    dependencies: Mapped[list["TaskDependency"]] = relationship("TaskDependency", foreign_keys="TaskDependency.task_id", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    dependents: Mapped[list["TaskDependency"]] = relationship("TaskDependency", foreign_keys="TaskDependency.depends_on_task_id", cascade="all, delete-orphan")


class TaskDependency(Base):
    __tablename__ = "task_dependencies"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("task_id", "depends_on_task_id", name="uq_task_dependency"),
    )

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    task_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("tasks.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True)

- Add HR to ROLE_HIERARCHY so admin includes hr (admin > hr) and hr is its own level
- Use `require_role(Role.ADMIN)` for writes (viewer can read, only admin can write)

Looking at the spec.md line 62-63:
> HR-only writes: Employees, Employee Satisfaction, Training, Hardware, Admin Process

So HR role + Admin should be allowed. Let me check if `require_role` can take multiple roles. Looking at the implementation:

```python
def require_role(required: Role) -> Callable[[User], User]:
    def _checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:  # noqa: B008
        if not role_includes(Role(user.role), required):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Insufficient role")
        return user
    return _checker
```

It takes a single role. The hierarchy-based check is: does the user's role include `required`? So:
- admin includes {admin, pm, designer, auditor, viewer}
- For "admin or hr": we can't directly check, but we can check `require_role(Role.HR)` where admin would need to include hr

So I'll add HR to be included by ADMIN. This means `require_role(Role.HR)` would allow admin + hr (but not pm/designer/auditor/viewer, since they wouldn't include HR).

Actually wait, I need to verify what "include" means. Currently ROLE_HIERARCHY:
```python
ROLE_HIERARCHY = {
    Role.ADMIN: {Role.ADMIN, Role.PM, Role.DESIGNER, Role.AUDITOR, Role.VIEWER},
    Role.PM: {Role.PM, Role.DESIGNER, Role.AUDITOR, Role.VIEWER},
    ...
}
```

So `role_includes(Role.ADMIN, Role.HR)` checks if `Role.HR` is in `{admin, pm, designer, auditor, viewer}`. For the HR check, I need to add `Role.HR` to the admin's allowed set:

```python
ROLE_HIERARCHY = {
    Role.ADMIN: {Role.ADMIN, Role.PM, Role.DESIGNER, Role.AUDITOR, Role.HR, Role.VIEWER},
    ...
    Role.HR: {Role.HR, Role.VIEWER},
}
```

Then `require_role(Role.HR)` would work for both admin and hr.
